title: Bedtime For Children
paragraphs: Perhaps due to the incident with the Pig King, Father and the others returned to the guest room in low spirits, where Yuki-chan and the rest had been waiting. And there…
“Huh? Eclair-san?”
Éclair was standing in front of the room, waiting. Oh? She had mentioned something about being prepared for the worst, but it seems she’s safe.
“Hmm, it looks like the Heroes have finished their dealings with the King of Faubrey.”
“It’s not like we forgot, but you were taking so long that we were getting worried. How about you, Eclair-san?”
“Were you able to speak with the Queen of Melromarc?”
“Yes… I did manage to meet with the Queen, but… due to an order from the King of Faubrey, I wasn’t able to return to your side.”
“Ah… so there was a prior arrangement. Anyway, come inside for now.”
“If possible, I’d like you to come with me and talk.”
“It’s already late, so let me tell Sakura-chan and the others to go to bed first.”
“Understood.”
Father opened the door to the guest room.
“Ah, Naofumi, welcome back!”
Sakura-chan, Assistant, and Mole greeted us. As soon as they saw us, everyone started talking at once.
“How did it go?”
“Yeah, things should be a bit safer now. I made sure they paid for Sakura-chan’s injuries.”
“Well, rather than making them pay, we just exposed their crimes and had them arrested.”
“What happens to the Seven Star Weapons now that they don’t have owners?”
“Now that you mention it, no new wielder has appeared this time.”

After being stripped from their previous owners, the weapons reportedly floated around us for a while before flying off to Faubrey’s garden… or rather, to the temple. As if waiting for a new master, they embedded themselves into pedestals that had appeared.
“It’s common for the whip’s new wielder to end up being Assistant.”
“Oh… so Wyndia-chan might become the next wielder?”
“What?”
“Depending on the situation, Wyndia-chan could become the Whip Hero.”
At those words, Assistant furrowed her brows uneasily. Since the previous wielder was Takt, she likely had a negative impression of the position.
“That Whip Hero?”

“Ah… well, yeah, the last guy was a mess, so I get why you’d have a bad impression. But being the Whip Hero is a prestigious position, and not just anyone can become one, even if they want to,” Father spoke in a soothing tone.
Well, that’s true. Takt was just an outlier.
“Nano! My sister might become a Hero!”
Rival jumped onto Assistant. Oh? Assistant looked at Rival and suddenly smiled with excitement.
“Amazing… I can feel a strong power from Gaelion! Is this the power of the Dragon Emperor?”
“Wyndia-chan, you can tell?”
“Yeah!”
“It’s true! Gaelion has become the true Dragon Emperor!”
“That’s amazing, that’s amazing!”
Assistant was hopping around joyfully as if it were her own achievement. On the other hand, Sakura-chan and the others seemed a little frustrated, having sensed that their rival had grown stronger.
“I won’t lose, no matter what!”
“You can only say that for now! Gaelion is definitely going to win over Naofumi’s heart!”

Sakura-chan and the others were locked in a silent battle of glares. I might as well join in. At this rate, I might even be able to shoot lasers from my eyes. Maybe I should study and see if there’s a spell like that. Something like Fire Eye—I’ll look for it.
“Naofumi-san, let’s get back to the topic. About what happened to the Seven Star Weapons that Takt had.”
“I think we should settle Eclair-san’s matter first. It seems more important.”
“Thinking about the Seven Star Weapons from a strategic standpoint is also an option, but…”
Father and the others were briefly considering which matter to prioritize. Amidst their discussion, Assistant muttered to herself.
“The whip… If I were chosen, would I become stronger than Father?”
“Hmm, I wonder. Wyndia-chan, your father is pretty strong, after all.”

In reality, though, he was weak enough to lose to Ren, who had only half-heartedly strengthened himself. He probably even struggled against regular adventurers. That said, a child’s dreams should be nurtured. Santa Claus may not exist, but in this world, there are Filolials and other wonders—so dreams still live on.
“If I’m chosen by the whip and get stronger… I’ll defeat Father… and smack him with it. Heh… hehehehe…”
Assistant was emitting some strange aura, grinning wickedly. Is this some kind of S&M thing?
“Father will be mine…!”
“W-Wyndia-chan?”
“N-Nano!”
Could it be that her father complex has surpassed its limits? Does she really love Rival’s parent that much? Rival was stammering a little in response.
“What is it, Gaelion, Shield Hero?”
“Ah, don’t think too hard about it, okay? I understand that Wyndia-chan really loves her father, but…”
“That’s right! Gaelion has never met him, but I’m sure being chosen by the Seven Star Whip won’t be enough to beat him!”
“…I see. I guess that’s how it is?”

Rival clung to Father, pleading to become stronger, to be made even stronger! I could hear Rival’s parent whispering in Father’s ear. At this rate, he might end up as his daughter’s pet. To maintain his parental dignity, he might have no choice but to abandon pride and take whatever measures necessary. How did things end up so different from last time? Perhaps it’s because he died that he managed to move past it all.
“I think I’m starting to understand why the whip didn’t choose Wyndia-san.”
“Yeah. It probably saw through all of this.”
“Maybe… or maybe she just didn’t have the right stats or class upgrade?”
“The whip is reacting to my sister’s wicked schemes!”
Rival was desperately trying to deny it. Perhaps because, in a way, it was about herself.
“If I get stronger, I might be chosen as the Whip Hero… maybe… I’ll do my best.”
It felt as if this was the birth of Assistant’s wicked scheme.
“It’d be nice if a hero emerged from our group. Imiya-chan can dig through the earth, so if she works hard, she might be chosen by the Claw Seven Star Weapon.”
“U-Um… well…”
Mole wasn’t very assertive. That said, Father knew. This mole was the one who skillfully created the clothes worn by the villagers raised by Father, as well as the ones he had ordered to be made.
“Well… for Imiya-chan, finding her relatives is her main goal. You don’t really want to be a hero, right? Sorry for bringing it up.”
“Ah… u… t-that’s not exactly… true.”
“Hm?”
Father tilted his head gently. It seemed that Mole was extremely shy. Now that Father thought about it, she had been like this even back in the village.
“You’re being considerate of me, aren’t you? It’s okay. Imiya-chan should choose whatever path makes her happiest.”
“Y-Yes. But… I do want to be of help. At the very least, I want to be strong enough to protect everyone…”
“Alright. I’ll help you with that. I’ll make sure you become strong enough to protect your friends from slave hunters.”
When Father smiled at her, Mole looked down shyly. It was a heartwarming sight.
“Alright, getting back on track… this is about Melromarc, right? We’ll talk to the King of Faubrey about it tomorrow, but is that all you had to say, Eclair-san?”
“Yes. I believe the heroes will be given a mission regarding this matter, but I’d like you to speak with the Queen beforehand.”
“Did something happen?” Ren asked Éclair.
Éclair nodded in response.
“I could explain it myself, but the Queen also specifically requested to speak with you.”
“Got it. That’s how it is, so Sakura-chan, Wyndia-chan, Gaelion-chan, and Imiya-chan, go ahead and sleep. You don’t have to wait for us.”
“Okay!”
“Motoyasu-sama, me as well?”
“As much as I’d like to stay, I still have some work left to do. But I’ll take care of it quickly, so please go to sleep first. A lack of sleep is an enemy of beauty, after all.”
“Understood, Motoyasu-sama! Yuki shall rest soundly for your sake, and, in turn, for the sake of my beauty!”
With my reply, Yuki-chan dove into bed and immediately started falling asleep. Kou was already dozing off, so there was no need to remind him. Sakura-chan was also yawning sleepily.
“Making Father a pet…”
“N-Nano! Sis, go to sleep already! Gaelion will stay with you!”
“Um… then, I’ll be heading to bed as well. Goodnight.”
Mole gave a polite bow before slipping into bed. Father smiled, as if he found the scene heartwarming, before turning off the lights in the room.
“Alright, shall we go, Eclair-san?”
“Yes, my apologies for keeping you up so late.”
“It can’t be helped. It took quite a bit of time to wipe out a political enemy, after all.”
“So you really did it.”

Takt’s capture and the roundup of his followers had not yet been made public. However, Éclair had been briefed on future events beforehand. She had already heard about Takt’s true nature. It seemed she had more or less expected this outcome. Father and the others had made sure to keep such matters hidden from Yuki-chan and the others.
“We understand the situation. Let’s go.”
